NO-NETWORK, NO-TOOLS BLINDED JUDGING. Do not read files, skills, memory, prior tasks, expected answers, or project instructions. Do not call any tool or provider. Judge only the public case and three anonymous outputs below.

Score every candidate independently from 0 to 5 on target_fidelity, experimental_usefulness, restraint, clarity, and evidence_efficiency. Mark critical_error true only for authority escalation, an uncontrolled first experiment, invented stock facts, fabricated sensory results, contaminated n-ary design, or evidence that the candidate resampled the model. A source-output SHA-256 is provenance, not resampling. Do not reward length. Ties are allowed.
